mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO theme.dev_masterplan (project_id, project_no, project_name, stage, stage_raw, approval_year, developer_name, src_municipality, municipality_code, src_district_id, src_community_id, masterplan_level, project_type, project_lead, owner_name, parent_project_no, area_sqm, centroid, geom) VALUES
(#{r.projectId}, #{r.projectNo}, #{r.projectName}, #{r.stage}, #{r.stageRaw}, #{r.approvalYear}, #{r.developerName}, #{r.srcMunicipality}, #{r.municipalityCode}, #{r.srcDistrictId}, #{r.srcCommunityId}, #{r.masterplanLevel}, #{r.projectType}, #{r.projectLead}, #{r.ownerName}, #{r.parentProjectNo}, round(ST_Area(::geography)::numeric, 2), , )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO theme.dev_masterplan_plot (src_objectid, project_id, masterplan_type, approval_status, udm_gisid, udm_plot_number, registered_land_use, land_use_l1, land_use_l2, plot_area_sqm, far, building_storeys, buildings, residential_population, total_residential_units, hotel_rooms, total_gfa, residential_gfa, office_gfa, retail_gfa, hotel_gfa, industrial_gfa, commercial_recreation_gfa, religious_gfa, education_gfa, healthcare_gfa, community_facilities_gfa, centroid, geom) VALUES
(#{r.srcObjectid}, #{r.projectId}, #{r.masterplanType}, #{r.approvalStatus}, #{r.udmGisid}, #{r.udmPlotNumber}, #{r.registeredLandUse}, #{r.landUseL1}, #{r.landUseL2}, #{r.plotAreaSqm}, #{r.far}, #{r.buildingStoreys}, #{r.buildings}, #{r.residentialPopulation}, #{r.totalResidentialUnits}, #{r.hotelRooms}, #{r.totalGfa}, #{r.residentialGfa}, #{r.officeGfa}, #{r.retailGfa}, #{r.hotelGfa}, #{r.industrialGfa}, #{r.commercialRecreationGfa}, #{r.religiousGfa}, #{r.educationGfa}, #{r.healthcareGfa}, #{r.communityFacilitiesGfa}, , )

INSERT INTO theme.dev_construction_site (site_id, description, municipality_code, area_sqm, centroid, geom) VALUES
(#{r.siteId}, #{r.description}, #{r.municipalityCode}, round(ST_Area(::geography)::numeric, 2), , )
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE theme.dev_masterplan m SET community_key = c.community_key, district_key = c.district_key, municipality_code = coalesce(c.municipality_code, m.municipality_code) FROM theme.sp_community c WHERE c.geom && m.centroid AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, m.centroid); UPDATE theme.dev_masterplan m SET district_key = d.district_key, municipality_code = coalesce(d.municipality_code, m.municipality_code) FROM theme.sp_district d WHERE m.district_key IS NULL AND d.geom && m.centroid AND ST_Intersects(d.geom, m.centroid)
UPDATE theme.dev_masterplan_plot m SET plot_key = p.plot_key FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE m.udm_gisid IS NOT NULL AND p.gisid = m.udm_gisid
UPDATE theme.dev_masterplan_plot m SET plot_key = p.plot_key FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE m.plot_key IS NULL AND p.cancel_date IS NULL AND p.geom && m.centroid AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, m.centroid)

UPDATE theme.dev_masterplan_plot m SET community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = p.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE p.plot_key = m.plot_key; UPDATE theme.dev_masterplan_plot m SET community_key = c.community_key, district_key = c.district_key, municipality_code = c.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_community c WHERE m.community_key IS NULL AND c.geom && m.centroid AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, m.centroid)

UPDATE theme.dev_construction_site s SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = coalesce(p.municipality_code, s.municipality_code) FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE p.cancel_date IS NULL AND p.geom && s.centroid AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, s.centroid); UPDATE theme.dev_construction_site s SET community_key = c.community_key, district_key = c.district_key, municipality_code = coalesce(c.municipality_code, s.municipality_code) FROM theme.sp_community c WHERE s.community_key IS NULL AND c.geom && s.centroid AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, s.centroid)

UPDATE theme.dev_construction_site s SET buildings = b.n FROM (SELECT construction_site_id::text AS site_id, count(*) AS n FROM theme.sp_building WHERE construction_site_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) b WHERE b.site_id = s.site_id
